''See also: [[Children of Nakothi Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The [[Children]] of [[Nakothi]] are monstrous entities created from human remains through the power of the [[Great Elder]] known as [[Nakothi]], also called the [[Dead Mother]]. These creatures are formed when [[Nakothi]]'s energy embeds itself into corpses, a process she uses to warp human bodies into specialized workers or minions. While they vary in appearance—ranging from bloated, blubbery forms to titanic, multi-limbed horrors with shifting, pulpy heads—they are unified by a mindless, singular bloodlust and an insatiable [[hunger]]. They can be summoned to battle by the [[Handmaiden]], a servant of [[Nakothi]], and are known to swarm in massive numbers, defiling any city they occupy. Though they possess a simple and focused mental nature rather than deep intelligence, they are dangerous enough to require significant combat skill or magical assistance to defeat. They are often associated with the stench of death and a disturbing blend of vibrant life and decay. Historically, [[Nakothi]] used these beings to shape her domain, which once encompassed the [[Heartland|Heartlands]], and she continues to seek a balance between life and death through their creation.}}

== Of Sea and Shadow ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|The [[Children]] of [[Nakothi]] are a group of [[Elderspawn]] stitched together from human corpses that [[Calder]] finds largely unfamiliar. Driven by a mindless [[hunger]], these entities seek to force the living into a deadly remaking. They have been observed swimming around the [[Aion]] and have launched attacks against the camp located on the island. Guided by the call of their [[Handmaiden]], the group is summoned to battle by her command.}}

== Of Shadow and Sea ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|The [[Children]] of [[Nakothi]] are deformed shapes formed when the power of [[Nakothi]] embeds itself within human remains. These creatures, often composed of various human parts, were created from ancient bodies by the Heart. During a fight, these entities arrived and began streaming around [[Naberius Clayborn|Naberius]]. As they continued to approach, the swarm gathered in the crater surrounding the arena to launch an attack and circled the [[Handmaiden]]. Amidst this chaos, [[Meia]] worked to rescue [[Watchmen]] from the creatures.}}
